STUDIO EYES is the studio's internal name for its reading-comfort instrument. Founder correction, reaffirmed 2026-08-08 from a live phone screenshot of index.html: it is not player-facing, and as the highest-contrast element on the front door it out-weighted the brand and the headline while anchoring the top of every screen. Measured that day: the words are visible to a reader in 103 files, 62 of them non-studio surfaces including student-facing ones (en195-*, arcade, choose-your-leader-*, cliche-*, rubric-forge, islo-hub). render_only because the bug is a READER SEEING the word -- a doc that discusses the name is the record, not the violation. except_paths because the name is CORRECT on studio/ surfaces.
